clips.title: The story
paras: Fine Crab Chunks come from the Reef Crawlers and Encrusted Tide Crawlers along Darkshore's coast. Gubber Blump seeks them for his cooking.

Reef Crawlers and Encrusted Tide Crawlers roam Darkshore's shores. Travelers may see them as pests or dangers by the water, while cooks prize their meat. The chunks can be boiled, broiled, fried, or added to stews.
